context: This criteria evaluates how well the engineer understands and uses the eslint-plugin-react-compiler package to configure the React Compiler ESLint rule with advanced options including severity level filtering and experimental bailout reporting modes.

checklist.name: Plugin registration
checklist.description: Correctly adds 'react-compiler' to the plugins array in the ESLint configuration object

checklist.name: Rule configuration
checklist.description: Correctly configures the 'react-compiler/react-compiler' rule with 'error' severity level in the rules object

checklist.name: ErrorSeverity enum import
checklist.description: Imports the ErrorSeverity enum from babel-plugin-react-compiler/src (the underlying compiler package used by eslint-plugin-react-compiler) to access InvalidReact, InvalidJS, and Todo severity levels

checklist.name: reportableLevels Set creation
checklist.description: Creates a Set containing ErrorSeverity enum values (InvalidReact, InvalidJS, Todo) and includes it in the rule options under the reportableLevels property

checklist.name: Bailout reporting option
checklist.description: Correctly sets the __unstable_donotuse_reportAllBailouts option to true in the rule options when bailout reporting is enabled

checklist.name: Default severity handling
checklist.description: Uses the default severity levels (ErrorSeverity.InvalidReact and ErrorSeverity.InvalidJS) when no severity levels are provided, matching the plugin's default behavior
